{{Quote|I'm going to have you help a local merchant named Ral Mundi. Mr. Mundi needs help tracking down a shipment of starship components that has gone missing. It's apparently very important to the survival of his business.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mack Jasper|Jasper]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FtMSOSC" />}}
'''Ral Mundi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Merchant/Legends|businessman]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You could help me track down my missing shipment. If you're able to find it, then not only will I be able to fulfill the order these two gentlemen placed, but I'll also be able to complete construction on my own starships.|Ral Mundi, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FtMSOSC" />}}
By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Ral Mundi was leading a shipwright company, [[Ral Mundi's Starship Emporium]], headquartered in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SWG:FtMSOSC" />

[[File:TsomcrenMundiJaxx.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Ral Mundi alongside [[Tarth Jaxx]] and [[Io Tsomcren]] waiting for the missing shipment.]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> an important shipment of starship components ordered by Ral Mundi disappeared during its transports, putting the company in trouble. Mundi put all of his available funds into this shipment and two shipwrights, [[Tarth Jaxx]] and [[Io Tsomcren]], were waiting for the shipment with impatience. Ral Mundi was afraid to not be able to pay back the shipwrights for the missing shipment, nor even be able to complete other projects. Ral Mundi's Starship Emporium was on the verge of ruin so Mundi requested the help of the [[Corellian Security Force]]. CorSec [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mack Jasper]] sent a spacer who worked with Ral Mundi and his assistant [[Abagga Creel]] to find information concerning the missing shipment.<ref name="SWG:FtMSOSC" /> The spacer later discovered that the shipment was stolen by the [[Ragtags]], with the help of one of Mundi's employees, [[Tomi Jinsin]], who was himself a Ragtag thug. The spacer retrieved the shipment in the [[Coronet Capitol]], along with a crate of illegal [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. The retrieval of the missing shipment saved the company from bankrupt and Mundi was indeed very grateful.<ref name="SWG:RtMSC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Reacquire the Missing Starship Component Shipment|Corellia}}</ref> Further investigation of the CorSec about the shipment robbery and the smuggled spice would led to the discovery of a plot of the [[Rogue CorSec]] to overthrow the [[Diktat]] [[Daclif Gallamby]] himself.<ref name="SWG:RtToaGD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Receive the Thanks of a Grateful Diktat|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Ral Mundi was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FtMSOSC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Ral Mundi, Tarth Jaxx and Io Tsomcren were added to the game with the expansion ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]'', released on [[October 27]], [[2004]]. This NPCs were originally three "greeter NPCs": NPCs present at the entrance of starports to provide general information to players arriving on a new planet.<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref> With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 21 Notes for 4 August 2005|Publish 21]]," on [[August 4]], [[2005]],<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> a new quest featuring Ral Mundi, Tarth Jaxx and Io Tsomcren was added to the game. The quest, named "Find the Missing Shipment of Starship Components", was best known as "Ral Mundi's quest".<ref name="SWG:TTE">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other}}Quest: "Find the Missing Shipment of Starship Components"</ref> Ral Mundi's quest was revamped with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 27 Notes for February 15th, 2006|Publish 27]]," on [[February 15]], [[2006]],<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 27 is now live!">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=66900&month=022006|text=Publish 27 is now live!}}</ref> as the quest was inserted into the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]," the main questline in the game.<ref name="SWG:FtMSOSC" /><ref name="SWG:RtMSC" />
